text: A keyword column shuffle writes the message in rows under a word and reads the columns in the word's alphabetical order. Here every word in the dictionary is the key, once forwards and once as the undoing.
After the shuffle a repeating secret word on the table must give the copper's letters where the known letters landed; two known letters in one slot of the word must agree.
459,268 routes, keys of 1 to 26 letters before or after: nothing below 22. The one count outside the scrambled coppers' range, period 23 after the move, is below it.
